vector_memory.semantic_summary: This module defines the core procedural logic for terrain generation, encapsulating rules that determine which terrain layer (e.g., grass, snow, rock) should occupy a specific world coordinate. It provides functions to calculate layer weights based on height, slope, and complex noise functions derived from 3D Perlin-like noise. The API includes utilities for constructing layer definitions, generating default terrain compositions, and packing layer properties into shader-consumable uniform arrays.
